task_description.overview: Reduce the sampling rate of a seismic trace by an integer factor while applying a low-pass filter to prevent aliasing, and compare raw, filtered, and downsampled data.
steps: Load the seismogram from the specified input file or URL.
Extract the trace object from the stream.
Copy the trace and apply an integer decimation (downsampling) by the desired factor. By default, apply a low-pass filter with corner frequency 0.4 * original_sampling_rate / factor.
Optionally, create another copy of the trace and apply only the low-pass filter (same filter parameters) without decimation.
Generate time vectors for the original, filtered, and downsampled traces.
Plot the three data series for visual comparison and document the processing steps in the trace metadata.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Load the seismogram from {seismogram_path}. Extract the trace and perform integer decimation by a factor of {decimate.factor}, automatically applying a low-pass filter with corner frequency 0.4 * original_sampling_rate / {decimate.factor}. Also apply the same filter without decimation to a copy of the trace. Generate time vectors for each series and plot raw, filtered, and downsampled data over a selected time window. Save the downsampled data to {downsampled_data} and the plot to {downsampled_data_plot}. Note: consider use the obspy package to do the downsampling and filtering.
